REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT ons SECTION AS ED Francisco Gold Condominium II EDSA Cor. Mapagmahal St., Diliman Quezon City LEGAL SERVICE DA TINE: CONTROL NO. DEC 26 2011 DILG Legal Opinion No. 96 s. 2011 VICE-MAYOR JOLY A. SOUTA Altavas, Aklan Dear Vice-Mayor Solita: This pertains to your letter seeking clarification from this Department regarding our legal authority to render the opinion dated 30 September 2011 addressed to the members of the Sangguniang Bayan despite the existence of the election protest filed by Mr. Joel F. Mayor. In reply thereto, please be informed that Section 7 (4) of the Rules and Regulations Implementing RA 6975 or the Department of the Interior and Local Government Act of 1991 provides: "xxx xxx xxx The Legal Service shall be responsible for providing the Department proper and the local government bureaus/offices with efficient and effective legal counseling services xxx." Based on the above-cited provision, it is therefore within the mandate of the DILG Legal Service to provide legal counseling which includes rendering legal opinions. It was due to such mandate that this Department thru this Service rendered the said opinion dated 30 September 2011. However, we would like to clarify that the said opinion informing the Sangguniang Bayan of Altavas, Aklan regarding the assumption of Punong Barangay Joel F. Mayor as ex-officio member of the Sangguniang Bayan of Altavas, Aklan was based on the representation of the letter sender Punong Barangay Joel F. Mayor and on the documents furnished to this Department which includes the Liga ng mga Barangay National Executive Board Resolution dated 16 December 2010 declaring Punong Barangay Joel F. Mayor as the duly elected President of Altavas, Province of Aklan Chapter. Further, please be informed that this Department was not furnished with a copy of the more recent Resolution of the Liga ng mga Barangay National Executive Board dated 20 January 2011 which granted the Motion for Reconsideration filed by Punong Barangay Hernan Catuiran and thus declared the latter as the duly elected Liga President of Altavas, Province of Aklan.

Page 12 This Department also received a copy of the Liga ng mga Barangay 5th National Liga Executive Board Resolution dated 2C) September 2011 remanding the Motion for Reconsideration of Punong Barangay Mayor to the Regional Chapter of Region VI. Thereafter, Provincial Director John Ace Azarcon, DILG Aklan again sought for clarification on the matter to which we rendered legal opinion dated 28 October 2011, provides in part and we quote: "Therefore, based on the Resolution dated 20 January 2011 of the National Executive Board, Liga ng mga Barangay sa Pilipinas, declaring Punong Barangay Catuiran as the duly elected Liga President of Altavas, Province of Aklan Chapter and based on the Certification of Confirmation in favor of Punong Barangay Catuiran, this Department is now of the view that Punong Barangay Catuiran may now assume as ex-officio member of the Sangguniang Bayan of Altavas, Aklan pending Resolution of the Motion of Punong Barangay Joel Mayor by the Liga ng mga Barangay sa Pilipinas Regional Chapter, Region VI". Attached herewith is a copy of the said legal opinion dated 28 October 2011 for your ready reference. Hope we have addressed your concern accordingly. Very truly yours, Direct UEAY Ill D LS:94/11
